criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Dark register and one hero throughout; 1, 2, 6, 7, 9 have real pools. Frame 3 shows no water, hood a wedge, waterline broken, no ledges or bank lamp. Frame 4's water an opaque rectangle with a solid comal trapezoid and a yellow-green grass band. Frame 8's car oversized, blue tinted, at desk height. Frame 5's field cars are boxes.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One world, key, hero, material and grade; no strobe; both devices work. Frames 8 and 7 sit slightly outside the street world.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces and the record quotes match. Faults, none a hard fail: frame 5's 'One is drawn here for each' is not visible; frame 4's kicker says the record while two labels are TPR's paraphrase; the mechanism rests on journalism where the Part 573 filing was not read; frames 6 then 7 invite a 177-day shutdown reading; first_comment lists 10 of about 19 cited claims and omits the February post; c25 is context_only yet published in the web edition.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who, where and the stake are named. Bexar County only in a hashtag. The next step gives no human-readable place to read.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns the swipe, turn on 3, close returns to the curb. Frame 2 steps back; 6 and 7 overlap.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and specific. One machine-flat caption line; the close's hook sounds administrative; 'Drawn to illustrate.' closes seven deks.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: No. 50 four days ago was a San Antonio night flood. One object per day repeats recent decks; a driverless vehicle led no. 41.

one_sentence_fix: Rebuild frame 3 so the car stands to its beltline in rippled creek water between limestone ledges with the bank lamp in frame, and make slide 5's dek true.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: No water reads; hood wedge; broken waterline; no ledges or lamp.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: standing_water sheet with ripple and opacity near 0.8 at the beltline, ledges and a lamp behind, one continuous comal line.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Opaque water with a solid comal trapezoid; yellow-green grass band.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Low roughness clearcoat mirroring streetlights, thin comal edge, dark wet shoulder for the grass.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Car at desk height, oversized, blue tinted.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Move the car 15 to 20 m back across a drawn street below the sill line.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Box primitive cars; only about 250 of 3791 framed, making the dek false.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Frame the whole block or change the dek; bevel the LOD windshield and add wheel arches.
